director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: Canonical corpus 419 experiments, 2 quarantined, 10 claims. Only C-MEAS-VALID, C-PARAM-INHERIT and C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY are EXPERIMENTAL; every other claim (C-CROSSSITE, C-FRESHNESS, C-DELTA-REPAIR, C-LLM-INHERIT, C-PRODUCT-ECON, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE, C-WEB-DYNAMICS) is HYPOTHESIS, and C-DELTA-REPAIR is effectively MEASUREMENT_INVALID. The integrated causal chain is still unproven: observation -> parameterized mechanism -> executable binding in the SHIPPED kernel -> applicability/freshness decision -> real external-agent action -> lower end-to-end successful-task cost on partially novel or cross-site work. Four lanes (frontier, graph, intel, runtime) carry already-frozen portfolio-mandated transactions that will resume independently of this decision: frontier on the hop-depth re-acquisition cost-scaling law, graph on a two-path extraction/value-blindness calibration separating an extraction defect from representation loss, intel on the pinned f* break-even determination, and runtime on the author-separated plus real-browser/write-path generalization of the VALIDATED intervention oracle. I preserve all four frozen transactions. The two idle lanes are Product and Physics. Product's parent handoff (the external-LLM four-arm benchmark) is known-blocked on an unprovisioned model credential and its arm-differentiation certificate already PASSED on a synthetic fixture, so I supersede it with the credential-free measurement the program actually lacks: SPIDER's own recurrence/novelty distribution and break-even reuse count under honest per-successful-task accounting. Physics has been idle since 2026-09-27 with 12 of its recent experiments on one estimator family and five consecutive MEASUREMENT_INVALID verdicts, so rather than repair the same query-parameter-perturbation observable a sixth time or park the domain, I reopen it on a materially different, cheap, real-Web observable: the predictability of server-minted action-gating values, which directly informs whether value-level inheritance can work at all. No lane is left silently dormant. The highest global bottleneck remains the kernel treatment path and the credential-free economics that make the eventual LLM comparison interpretable; the two live-lane mandates below target exactly those.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout ran in DEGRADED SCOUT MODE (model unavailable, rc=124) with no external reconnaissance and no spider_evidence, so its brief could not itself change any direction and was treated as staff advice only. Its candidate directions for the four frozen lanes (frontier hop-depth cost scaling, graph two-path extraction/value-blindness, intel pinned f* break-even, runtime author/transport generalization) match the already-frozen mandates and are recorded as corroboration, not authority. I explicitly challenged the two Scout suggestions that did matter: its physics direction was a repair of the exhausted query-parameter-perturbation family, which I superseded for a materially different observable; and its product direction was to re-run the blocked four-arm benchmark or 'keep the lane gated,' which I superseded with a credential-free own-distribution economics measurement so the idle lane is reactivated on useful work rather than parked on an absent credential. The Scout's own questions for the Director (which blocker most constrains residual-novelty economics; which lanes are repeating measurement-repair whose prerequisite belongs in Runtime/Product; which thread would be chosen with no parent handoff) are answered directly by these allocations.
